column1: # The cells of the calculation type table as test cases, see docs/spec/calculation.md.
# Columns: target, expression, operands a, b and c, expected result.
# An operand is type[value], set as in conversion.tsv (a c, n, d or t holds exactly the characters given, any other
# type gets the given text converted to it); <a>=type[value] is a field symbol TYPE any assigned to such a variable;
# - is an unused operand. The target is the type of the result field of `result = expression.`; type[value] is a
# result field with that start value for an assignment operator (`result += a.`); DATA is an inline declaration
# `DATA(result) = expression.`, whose expected result is type:value. Values read as in conversion.tsv: text in [],
# x and xstring as hex digits, f as the hex digits of its IEEE 754 bits, decfloat as d.ddd with a four-digit
# exponent, p with all its decimals. EXC: names the exception raised, SYNTAX means the statement is a syntax error.
